papers.title: Post office slip
lines: The Penguin Post Office at Port Lockroy sends postcards worldwide. Each is hand-stamped by a woman in thick gloves.
The penguins supervise. They are very strict.

papers.title: Researcher's note
lines: The ice core is a tube of frozen time. The top is last winter. The bottom is older than our species.
Held it in my hands this morning. Warm hands, very old ice.

papers.title: Midwinter card
lines: Midwinter's Day: a meal, a toast, and a film everyone has seen eleven times.
No sun for weeks. We make our own. It is called a dinner.

papers.title: Station note
lines: Under the Antarctic Treaty, the continent is for peace and science. We take it seriously.
We also take our boots seriously. The hut has twenty pairs and none that fit.
